title: The Siege of Jerusalem

questions.question: How the gold has grown dim, how the pure gold is what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:1 (ESV): "How the gold has grown dim, how the pure gold is changed!"

questions.question: The holy stones lie scattered at the head of every what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:1 (ESV): "The holy stones lie scattered at the head of every street."

questions.question: The precious sons of Zion, worth their weight in fine gold, are now regarded as what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:2 (ESV): "how they are regarded as earthen pots, the work of a potter's hands!"

questions.question: Even the jackals offer the breast; they nurse their young; but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the what in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:3 (ESV): "but the daughter of my people has become cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness."

questions.question: Those who feasted on delicacies perish in the what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:5 (ESV): "Those who feasted on delicacies perish in the streets;"

questions.question: The punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:6 (ESV): "For the chastisement of the daughter of my people has been greater than the punishment of Sodom,"

questions.question: Her princes were purer than snow, whiter than milk; their bodies were more ruddy than what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:7 (ESV): "Her princes were purer than snow... their bodies were more ruddy than coral,"

questions.question: Now their face is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:8 (ESV): "Now their face is blacker than soot; they are not recognized in the streets;"

questions.question: Happier were the victims of the sword than the victims of what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:9 (ESV): "Happier were the victims of the sword than the victims of hunger,"

questions.question: The hands of compassionate women have boiled their own what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:10 (ESV): "The hands of compassionate women have boiled their own children;"

questions.question: The LORD gave full vent to his wrath; he poured out his hot anger, and he kindled a fire in where?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:11 (ESV): "he kindled a fire in Zion that consumed its foundations."

questions.question: Who did not believe that the adversary and the enemy would enter the gates of Jerusalem?
options: The kings of the earth and all the inhabitants of the world
questions.correctAnswer: The kings of the earth and all the inhabitants of the world
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:12 (ESV): "The kings of the earth did not believe, nor any of the inhabitants of the world,"

questions.question: This was for the sins of her prophets and the iniquities of her priests, who shed in the midst of her the blood of whom?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:13 (ESV): "who shed in the midst of her the blood of the righteous."

questions.question: Our pursuers were swifter than the eagles in the heavens; they chased us on the what?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:19 (ESV): "they chased us on the mountains;"

questions.question: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of where?
questions.explanation: Lamentations 4:21 (ESV): "Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, you who dwell in the land of Uz;"

key_verse_text: How the gold has grown dim, how the pure gold is changed! The holy stones lie scattered at the head of every street.
